title: Follow-Up, Outcome, Reentry, and Repair acceptance matrix

criteria.statement: Initial Portia/Core anchors and current Meridian context are recorded.
Pre-ADR and final drift checks are recorded.
Published schemas are not modified in place.
Follow-Up, Outcome, Reentry, and Repair semantic units are explicit.
Event/Support Process work-local ownership decision is explicit.
#17 Response/Communication and #18 plan/Implementation/Fidelity boundaries remain intact.
#20 paper/import and #21 privacy/export/retention boundaries remain intact.
Teacher-local scope is explicit.
Follow-Up has opaque identity, canonical path, explicit target, owner, purpose, timing, workflow state, lifecycle, and provenance.
owner is distinct from recorder/target/provider/authority.
scheduled, overdue-derived, completed, cancelled, and unable states are not conflated.
completion does not imply favorable Outcome.
completion links exact produced records without copying payload.
later Follow-Ups remain distinct history.
substantive perspective remains Account, contact remains Communication, direct measurement remains Observation.
recipient/participation/agreement/decline/unavailability/withdrawal remain distinct.
no engagement/cooperation score is introduced.
Outcome has opaque identity and one bounded attributed evaluation unit.
evaluator, target, question/scope, timeframe, basis, result, and limitations are explicit.
later timeframe normally creates a new Outcome rather than correction.
Goal status exact-links Goal and does not rewrite it.
observed change is target/measure-specific.
raw measurement remains Observation where sufficient.
evidence roles and exact history are explicit.
missingness and `unable_to_determine` are first-class.
positive progress is representable without rankings/universal percentage.
recurrence requires explicit timeframe and coverage.
later Event does not automatically mean recurrence/failure.
no later Event does not prove no recurrence.
ordinary Outcome does not contain causal-effect fields.
"effectiveness" is resolved without a universal boolean/score.
Fidelity and Outcome remain distinct.
adverse/unintended change is representable without causal overclaim.
Support Process review uses Follow-Up/Outcome rather than broadening Event Review.
review completion is distinct from conclusion/disposition.
favorable Outcome does not auto-close; unfavorable Outcome does not auto-adapt/intensify.
explicit human disposition can drive revision-aware workflow-state update.
plan adaptation continues to use #18 successor semantics.
process completion remains distinct from causal success/resolution.
Reentry has opaque identity, ownership, target, coordinator, exact context, timing/context, planned elements, workflow state, lifecycle, and provenance.
coordinator is distinct from recorder/authority.
existing Support/Intervention is referenced rather than cloned.
actual actions remain existing canonical families.
date passage/person return does not auto-complete all reentry work.
completed Reentry does not imply safety/compliance/rehabilitation.
post-reentry check is separate Follow-Up.
optional Portia steps do not create unauthorized access barriers.
restricted safety/clinical processes remain external/minimally linked.
no readiness score is introduced.
Repair has opaque identity and is distinct from Response/Communication/Determination/Outcome.
neutral participant roles and voluntary participation states are defined.
decline/unavailability/withdrawal are nonjudgmental.
affected-person participation/direct meeting/apology is not mandatory.
Repair focus does not overwrite source evidence.
agreement/action modeling decision is explicit.
`repair_action@1` is not added without independent semantic justification.
restitution does not become debt/collections tracking.
completion does not imply remorse, forgiveness, rehabilitation, or relationship restoration.
relationship change is separate Outcome if evaluated.
no engagement/remorse/sincerity score is introduced.
lifecycle/workflow/correction policy is explicit for each family.
later evaluation is distinct from correction.
Amendment policy and family successor reasons are explicit.
exact refs never silently follow successors.
disagreement, dependency, migration, ownership correction, removal compatibility is demonstrated.
operation/lock/Quarantine/Integrity Finding reuse is demonstrated.
derived state remains rebuildable/nonauthoritative/privacy-minimized.
missing derived state never proves absence.
cross-year Support continuity preserves old #19 records exactly.
paper templates do not fabricate completion, Outcome, agreement, participation, or judgment.
current-use import/paper gating remains #20.
native payloads minimize sensitive/restricted content.
no automatic progress/recurrence/effectiveness/closure/adaptation/Reentry/Repair inference is introduced.
no compliance/engagement/remorse/competence inference is introduced.
Core v0.6 `intervention_outcomes` compatibility is considered.
Portia owns native Outcome semantics; #19 does not implement producer publication or Meridian adapter.
Outcome does not become Score/standards rating/Grade or automatic portfolio content.
accepted public Draft 2020-12 schemas and collision-checked identifiers are added.
schema catalog is updated.
valid, structural-invalid, and application-invalid coverage is complete.
cross-record/causality/closure/reentry/repair invariants are tested.
existing and full schema-validation suites pass.
`git diff --check` passes.
design document and accepted ADR are complete.
at least 40 synthetic examples are documented.
application-invalid and acceptance matrices are complete.
final validation/checkpoint docs and README/schema-guide reconciliation are complete.
no real student/family/staff data is committed.
